description: Full-featured Ubuntu KDE Plasma desktop with the complete LinuxServer.io toolset (browsers, file manager, productivity apps, dev utilities). Multi-arch (amd64 + arm64), updated daily.
notes: Image is from LinuxServer.io webtop. Listens on port 3000 by default; you may need to map it to Kasm's 6901 or run with --network host. PUID/PGID env vars are typically required.
